samples.stimulus: In the pie chart shown, each section represents one category of the favorite activity chosen by the visitors to a park. The size of each section is labeled as a percent of the whole. One visitor is chosen at random from the group. It is known that the chosen visitor did not belong to the category "Kayaking". Refer to the pie chart when answering the question that follows.
samples.question: What is the probability that the chosen visitor is in the category "Picnics"?
samples.explanation: (1) 원그래프에서 각 부채꼴의 값을 읽는다: Hiking 30%, Biking 10%, Kayaking 15%, Picnics 20%, Camping 25%. (2) Kayaking 가 아닌 것은 85% 이다. (3) Picnics 는 20% 이다. (4) 확률 = 20 ÷ 85 이다. (5) 따라서 답은 4/17 이다. 따라서 정답은 4/17이다.
